content: It is easier to appear worthy of the positions one does not hold than of those one does.
author: François de La Rochefoucauld
sourceWork: Memoirs of the Regency of Anne of Austria
story:
This insight touches directly on the messy reality of human nature. Thinking about doing something gives us a comfortable dopamine hit of progress without any of the actual friction. We often use over-researching and planning as socially acceptable disguises for fear of starting.

François de La Rochefoucauld understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Clarity follows action; it does not precede it. You cannot think your way into a new way of living—you have to act your way into a new way of understanding. The smallest real-world step beats the most brilliant theory.
